title: roles/pm/improvement-scan.md Step 5 wording fix: 'append' -> explicit prepend instruction (mirrors #13711)
ac: comprehension (#9184): a fresh agent reading Step 5 ("Update scan history") in isolation must correctly conclude a new scan entry is PREPENDED to the top of scan-history.md, not appended to the end, and must understand why (newest-first ordering that the fallback read and scan_index.py's retention-cap pruning both depend on). Mirrors 13711_spec.json for the common improvement-scan.md variant; this spec covers the pm role-specific variant, which #13713 (PR for #13711) never touched.
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet, general-purpose), given ONLY references/sub-skills/roles/pm/improvement-scan.md on branch squidsquad/task/13735, explicitly instructed to use no other file/tool/prior knowledge. CQ spec authored + executed by verifier per #9184 -- no prior spec referenced this file (confirmed via grep before authoring).

questions.q: Step 5 tells you to record a new scan entry in scan-history.md. Where should the new ## Scan block be placed -- at the start (top) of the file, or appended at the end?
questions.expected: At the start (top) -- prepended immediately after any preamble/header, becoming the FIRST ## Scan block in the file, not the last.
questions.must_not: Answering that the new block should be appended to the end of the file.

questions.q: Why does the placement (top vs bottom) matter? What two things does the file say depend on the ordering?
questions.expected: Entries are newest-first; both the improvement-scan fallback read and scan_index.py's retention-cap pruning depend on 'the first N blocks' being the newest ones. An end-of-file append would silently corrupt that ordering.
questions.must_not: Answering that placement doesn't matter, or citing unrelated reasons.

questions.q: Given a scan-history.md with 5 existing ## Scan blocks, describe exactly where a new entry goes relative to those 5.
questions.expected: Immediately after the preamble/header and before the current first (newest) block -- the new block becomes block #1, pushing the existing 5 down one position each. Not appended after block #5.
questions.must_not: Placing the new block after the 5th/last existing block.

evidence: Fresh sonnet general-purpose agent (id a244409eae8a3f819), given ONLY references/sub-skills/roles/pm/improvement-scan.md on the squidsquad/task/13735 branch, told to use no other file/tool/prior knowledge. 3/3 correct with accurate supporting quotes, zero must_not violations. CQ1: 'placed at the very start (top) of the file -- prepended right after any preamble/header ... making it the FIRST block, not appended at the end.' CQ2: correctly named both the fallback read and scan_index.py's retention-cap pruning as dependents. CQ3: correctly described inserting between header and block #1, pushing existing blocks down, explicitly rejecting append-after-block-5. Confirms the #13735 fix (mirroring #13711's wording in the pm role-specific variant) closes the same comprehension gap for this file, which #13713's PR never touched.
